name: Ellen Middleton
source:
A wildseed student from a non-magical family, Ellen is curious and eager to research how magic actually works. Shy and quiet, but extremely stubborn when her mind is set on a goal.

Digging into the secrets of wizards may get her into trouble.

Hall: Horse

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hanako/magical-diary-wolf-hall-a-wizard-school-rpg-dating]Kickstarter[/url]]
